intro.text: A Shin holy site in the rocky highlands east of Ayabiza, half a day's walk from the city.

description.text: Unlike the other monasteries, it is a natural enclosure among rocks. The Sheathing of Swords contains nine hollows used to hold the Honorblades.
A nearby cavern contains the chamber where prospective Honorbearers meet the Voice.

items.text: Szeth reached the site at the end of his training pilgrimage. Inside the cavern, he found spren pinned to the walls and fled rather than submit to the Voice.
Ishar received Szeth, Kaladin and Nale at the monastery. Szeth faced the Honorbearers while Kaladin sought to persuade Ishar to release Shinovar.
Ishar renewed the Oathpact at the site, with Kaladin taking Jezrien's place and the Heralds' minds sheltered from Braize.
